subject: Next steps: COI clarifications and staggered PO timeline for LumenScale
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@lumenscale.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LumenScale Procurement <procurement@lumenscale.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: COI and PO cadence for Redwood integration

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get the pilot started. Procurement asked me to send the initial documents they need to start vendor onboarding. Attached are our current COI and W-9.

Quick Qs from our side so we can align internal approvals:
- Is Redwood able to accept a phased PO (monthly increments) while we finalize a year-long SOW?
- For the COI, you list "Redwood Inference, Inc." as additional insured. Can you confirm the exact wording you need for the endorsement (carrier is open to editing)?

Attaching: LumenScale_COI.pdf, W9_LumenScale.pdf

LMK if you want these uploaded to a portal or sent to procurement@redwoodinference.com.

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Head of Cloud Partnerships
LumenScale Technologies
[attachment: LumenScale_COI.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: W9_LumenScale.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@lumenscale.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: COI and PO cadence for Redwood integration

Alex — appreciated, and welcome aboard. Sharing procurement and finance to confirm the quick points below.

Karthik / Grace / Sean — quick answers below and next steps:
1) Phased PO: We can often accept a time-boxed/phase PO for pilots. Finance needs a short memo (+expected total ARR) and sign-off on invoice cadence.
2) COI endorsement language: We require "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors and employees" as Additional Insured; waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood is preferred for accounts with data access.

Alex — if your carrier can issue the endorsement with that language, we can proceed. Also useful: certificate name exactly as on file: Redwood Inference, Inc., 1107 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103.

I'll coordinate PO cadence once Marcus confirms billing/recognition details. If you can share a proposed PO schedule (monthly vs quarterly) that helps speed review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[signature block]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@lumenscale.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: COI and PO cadence for Redwood integration

Looping in finance (Marcus) and legal (Grace) for the endorsement and PO structure.

Marcus — for pilot economics, can we accept a monthly PO of $12,000 for three months (covers reserved capacity + initial integration)? If so, we can draft a short purchase order and route for signature.

Grace — any legal flags on the endorsement language Marissa asked for? If the carrier provides the Additional Insured endorsement and waiver of subrogation, are we good to accept without further amendments?

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@lumenscale.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: COI and PO cadence for Redwood integration

All — finance confirms we can process a chained PO schedule: month-by-month for the pilot with a single master reference to the eventual SOW. Two notes:
- We need the exact PO line items and expected invoice timing; ideally invoices on first of month to keep recognition clean.
- For revenue recognition we need an expected total contract value (even if estimated) to book the pilot properly.

Proposed action: Alex, can you send a one-sheet with the pilot scope + proposed monthly PO amounts? If you can also fill the attached schedule (I created a quick spreadsheet) we can turn the PO in 48 hours. Attaching Proposed_PO_Schedule.xlsx.

Marcus Lin
Sr. Finance Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Proposed_PO_Schedule.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@lumenscale.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: COI and PO cadence for Redwood integration

Thanks everyone — quick update and uploads.

1) Carrier updated COI to include: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors and employees" and issued a CG 20 10 endorsement. I've attached the revised COI (LumenScale_COI.pdf).
2) Attached the completed Proposed_PO_Schedule.xlsx with monthly $12k entries for July–September and an estimate field for the full SOW.
3) We can route invoices on the 1st of each month.

If legal needs any additional wording I can ask the carrier for an amended endorsement; otherwise please confirm and I'll get procurement to issue the first PO.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Alex
Head of Cloud Partnerships
LumenScale Technologies
